title: Wheels Manufacturing: how to select the correct T47 bottom bracket
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. The selection table lists T47-OUT-30MM (for 30 mm spindles) as outboard with a 68 mm frame shell and 90.8 mm over-seal width, and 73 mm shell with 95.8 mm; T47-OUT-29MM and T47-OUT (24 mm, for Shimano, FSA and others) show the same 68/90.8 and 73/95.8 pairs. Shell width and over-seal width are different dimensions. This is a manufacturer's product guide, not a recommendation for any catalog frame.
